      - text: "given", the given of the vaccine.

program:
app "Tuition" school plum
table student name text, fee money
table feepaid student ref student, amount money
table exam subject text, on_date date
table teacher name text, salary money
state m date = today
monthnav m
"Profit this month" sum(feepaid.amount month of m) - sum(teacher.salary) big
row gap 2
  stat sum(feepaid.amount month of m), "fees collected"
  stat sum(teacher.salary), "salaries"
  stat count(student), "students"
"Fees not yet paid this month" head
each student as s
  if sum(s.feepaid.amount month of m) < s.fee
    row card
      s.name grow
      s.fee - sum(s.feepaid.amount month of m) color bad
"Exams" head
each exam sort on_date as e
  row card tap edit e swipe remove e
    e.subject bold grow
    e.on_date
form student, "Add student"
form feepaid, "Add fee payment"
form exam, "Add exam"
form teacher, "Add teacher"
describe:
Tuition, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- student: name: text; fee: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- feepaid: student: a student; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- exam: subject: text; on date: date. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- teacher: name: text; salary: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today.
Shows:
- arrows that move m back and forward one month.
- text: "Profit this month", the total amount of feepaid in the month of m minus the total salary of teacher.
- a big number: the total amount of feepaid in the month of m, labelled "fees collected".
- a big number: the total salary of teacher, labelled "salaries".
- a big number: how many student entries, labelled "students".
- text: "Fees not yet paid this month".
- for each student:
  - if the total amount of the student's feepaid entries in the month of m is less than the fee of the student:
    - text: the name of the student.
    - text: the fee of the student minus the total amount of the student's feepaid entries in the month of m.
- text: "Exams".
- for each exam sorted by on date:
  - a group; a tap opens the exam for editing; a swipe removes the exam, with undo:
    - text: the subject of the exam.
    - text: the on date of the exam.
- a form to add a student.
- a form to add a feepaid.
- a form to add a exam.
- a form to add a teacher.

app "Household bills" home slate
table bill what text, amount money, category pick Electricity|Gas|Water|Internet|Rent
let spent = sum(bill.amount month)
setting budget money = 60000 "Monthly budget"

daybars last 7 days, sum(bill.amount on it)

remind "Add today's expenses" every 2h from 9:00 to 21:00

- spent is the total amount of bill this month.

- text: "Safe to spend", the larger of budget minus spent and 0 divided by the result of the number of days in the month of today minus the day of the month of today plus 1 rounded, "a day".

app "Books for sale Buddy" book plum
table title_stock name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 5, price money?, kind pick Home|Work|Other, expires date?

short "books running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)

  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i

      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)

    i.qty bold

"Stock value" sum(title_stock, it.qty * it.price) faint
form title_stock
describe:

table refuel liters num 0.., price money, odo num 0..

setting interval num = 4500 "Oil change every (km)"
let km = max(refuel.odo) - min(refuel.odo)

interval - since_oil "km left" faint

list refuel by day
